title: A Foot From the Line
scene: Division Street. The checkpoint gate, two figures behind the sawhorses, and the Beetle rolling the last fifty feet at the speed it was told. It stops with the front bumper a foot from the line and no squeal. Mya is asleep in the passenger seat. Gracie is on the dashboard, yelling silently through the glass. Mom doesn't run — nobody runs anymore — she walks fast, very quiet, and holds on.
debrief: Two hundred and eighty miles, one pass, one bridge, one convoy. The car is where it was aimed and everyone in it is alive.
